facts.statement: The RBI raised the risk weights on unsecured retail loans by 25 basis points on 16th November 2023.
facts.subject: risk weights on unsecured retail loans
facts.evidence_quote: the RBI had, on 16th November 202336, raised the risk weights on unsecured retail loans by 25 basis points.

facts.statement: The gross non-performing assets in the banking system declined to 2.6 per cent of gross loans and advances as of December 2024.
facts.subject: gross non-performing assets in the banking system
facts.predicate: as a percentage of gross loans and advances
facts.evidence_quote: the gross non-performing assets (NPAs) in the banking system have declined to a 12-year low of 2.6 per cent of gross loans and advances.

facts.statement: The capital-to-risk-weighted assets ratio for scheduled commercial banks stands at 16.7 per cent as of September 2024.
facts.subject: capital-to-risk-weighted assets ratio for scheduled commercial banks
facts.evidence_quote: The capital-to-risk-weighted assets ratio (CRAR) for SCBs stands at 16.7 per cent as of September 2024

facts.statement: The profit after tax of scheduled commercial banks surged by 22.2 per cent YoY during H1 FY25.
facts.subject: profit after tax of scheduled commercial banks
facts.evidence_quote: profit after tax (PAT) surging by 22.2 per cent YoY

facts.statement: The average duration of cycles where credit growth exceeds deposit growth is 41 months.

facts.evidence_quote: the average duration of such cycles where credit growth exceeds deposit growth is 41 months.

facts.statement: As of September 2024, 51.9 per cent of the fresh addition to the stock of NPAs in the retail loan portfolio emanated from slippages in the unsecured loan book.

facts.predicate: emanated from slippages in the unsecured loan book
facts.evidence_quote: As of September 2024, 51.9 per cent of the fresh addition to the stock of NPAs in the retail loan portfolio emanated from the slippages in the unsecured loan book.

facts.statement: The unemployment rate for individuals aged 15 years and above declined from 6 per cent in 2017-18 to 3.2 per cent in 2023-24.
facts.subject: unemployment rate for individuals aged 15 years and above
facts.predicate: declined from 6 per cent in 2017-18 to
facts.evidence_quote: the unemployment rate for individuals aged 15 years and above has steadily declined from 6 per cent in 2017-18 to 3.2 per cent in 2023-24.

facts.statement: In Q2 FY25, the urban unemployment rate for people aged 15 years and above was 6.4 per cent.

facts.evidence_quote: In Q2 FY25, the urban unemployment rate for people aged 15 years and above improved slightly to 6.4 per cent

facts.evidence_quote: compared to 6.6 per cent in Q2 FY24.
